isolated_participant.instructions: Play Riichi Mahjong for only this seat. Choose one offered legal action. Tile IDs 0..135 have kind ID // 4: kinds 0..8 are 1m..9m, 9..17 are 1p..9p, 18..26 are 1s..9s; 27..33 are East, South, West, North, White, Green, Red. Physical IDs 16, 52 and 88 are red fives. Your hand and public_table are the only available tile information. Do not guess wall order or another hand. The engine scores, validates and resolves all moves.

payloads.runtime/ruleset.yaml:
sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pneuma.small
features: {}
abilities: {}
tools:
  _helper:
    description: Helper.
    parameters:
    - name: target
      type: string
      description: Target
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _x
        value: 1
    narrative:
      success: Rolled 1 for True.
  roll_once:
    description: Roll.
    parameters:
    - name: target
      type: string
      description: Target
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _x
        value: 2
    narrative:
      success: Rolled 2 for Ash.
  pick_one:
    description: Pick.
    parameters:
    - name: choice
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - a
      - b
      required: false
    - name: who
      type: entity_id
      resolve: participant
    - name: many
      type: entity_id_list
      resolve: entity_list
      min_items: 1
      max_items: 3
      unique_items: true
    - name: level
      type: integer
      from_state: participant.level
    - name: count
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 9
      default: 1
    pre_conditions:
    - 'true'
    effects:
    - publish:
        value: joined(x)
    narrative:
      success: Picked.
    metadata:
      tier: 1.5
procedures:
  tick:
    trigger: on_turn_end
    steps:
    - spatial_query:
        operation: path
        query:
          moving_entity_id: a
definitions:
  table:
    a: 1
narrative: {}
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong
    key: state.actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong
    key: entities
  participant_control:
    field: control
    player_values:
    - player
    actor_participant_field: participant_id
  default_owner: gm
  isolated_participant:
    instructions: 'Play Riichi Mahjong for only this seat. Choose one offered legal
      action. Tile IDs 0..135 have kind ID // 4: kinds 0..8 are 1m..9m, 9..17 are
      1p..9p, 18..26 are 1s..9s; 27..33 are East, South, West, North, White, Green,
      Red. Physical IDs 16, 52 and 88 are red fives. Your hand and public_table are
      the only available tile information. Do not guess wall order or another hand.
      The engine scores, validates and resolves all moves.'
    observation_path:
    - game
    persona_path:
    - persona
    actions_path:
    - game
    - decision_actions
    public_observation:
      namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong
      key: state.public_observation
